name: Kawaii Trader Icons
teaser: Replace trader images with KAWAII images.
description_html:
- Sourse mod

This mod was made using jbs4bmx’s Alternative Trader Pics, thanks to jbs4bmx.

(No need to install it as it is included in this mod)

- Installation

Extract the contents of the zip file to the “root” of your SPT folder. (The same location as EscapeFromTarkov.exe, Aki.Launcher.exe, and Aki.Server.exe)

Before launching the game…

Start both Server and Launcher.

In Launcher, click on Settings.

In Settings, click on ‘Clear Temp Files’.

In Settings, click arrow on right side to return to the Launcher main menu.

Launch the game by clicking on ‘Start Game’.

Enjoy.

If you like KAWAII images, please buy me a cup of coffee.
